raw_graphql_pull_request.body:
## Motivation

With `--tokenizer-worker-num > 1`, uvicorn starts the HTTP/tokenizer workers with the `spawn` start method. Before a spawned worker unpickles its target, `multiprocessing` re-runs the parent's main module in it. For `python -m sglang.launch_server` that main module imports `sglang.srt.server_args`, `sglang.srt.utils` and therefore torch and transformers. All of this runs before uvicorn's health-check (ping) thread exists in the worker.

On a CPU-oversubscribed host this import takes longer than `SGLANG_UVICORN_WORKER_HEALTHCHECK_TIMEOUT` (10 s). The supervisor then kills the worker as unresponsive and spawns a new one, which pays the same import again.

Re-import time of `sglang.launch_server` as `__mp_main__` (what each spawned worker runs before it can answer a ping). Fresh interpreter, 16 CPUs (`taskset`) of an AMD Threadripper PRO 7965WX, N busy-loop processes on the same CPUs, median of 3:

| busy loops on 16 CPUs | 0 | 24 | 48 | 96 |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| `python -m sglang.launch_server` main re-import | 2.19 s | 6.78 s | 8.82 s | **18.99 s** |
| with this PR (uvicorn imports only) | — | — | 0.19 s | — |

**Scope of the problem on current main.** It needs heavy CPU oversubscription and the `python -m sglang.launch_server` entrypoint:
- At 3x oversubscription (48 busy loops on 16 CPUs) the re-import stays just under the 10 s timeout, and no worker is killed.
- At 6x (96 busy loops) it takes 19 s, and workers are killed on start-up and on respawn (see below).
- The `sglang serve` console script re-runs only `sglang.cli.main` (0.83 s at 48 busy loops), so the recommended entrypoint is much less exposed.

The fix is still worth having: `python -m sglang.launch_server` is supported and widely used in scripts and tests. With the fix, a worker answers health checks after only the uvicorn imports (0.19 s), however slow the launcher module is. It covers sglang's own launchers only; a user's launcher script is still re-run in every worker, as on main.

**Related: #47838** (open) addresses the same kill-and-respawn loop from another cause: under `CUDA_MODULE_LOADING=EAGER`, the CUDA init during the worker's `import sglang` outlasts the health check. That `import sglang` still happens with this PR, because the worker imports the app module, so the two fixes are complementary and neither covers the other. They edit different hunks of `http_server.py`, and this branch merges cleanly with #47838's head.

## Modifications

- `python/sglang/srt/entrypoints/uvicorn_worker_spawn.py`: `skip_main_reimport_in_spawned_workers()` is a context manager. When the server was started by sglang's own entrypoint (`python -m sglang.launch_server`, or the `sglang` console script), it drops `init_main_from_name` / `init_main_from_path` from `multiprocessing.spawn.get_preparation_data()` while it is active. A uvicorn worker unpickles only uvicorn objects and imports the app from an import string (`SGLANG_HTTP_SERVER_APP_PATH`), so it needs nothing from `__main__`. The original function is restored on exit.
- A user's own launcher script (e.g. `if __name__ == "__main__": launch_server(...)` after module-level model registration or patches) is still re-run in every worker, exactly as on main.
- `http_server.py`: the multi-worker uvicorn supervisor (`uvicorn.run` and the `--enable-http-worker-reuseport` supervisor) runs inside that context. Health-check timeouts are unchanged, so a frozen live worker is still killed.
- `init_multi_tokenizer()` calls `suppress_noisy_warnings()`. Workers no longer run the launcher module that applied these warning filters at import.
- The single-tokenizer path and the Granian HTTP/2 path are unchanged.

## Accuracy Tests

No model-output change. Exactness gate: same GPU, same image, `--enable-deterministic-inference --tokenizer-worker-num 2`, Qwen/Qwen2.5-0.5B-Instruct, 4 greedy prompts x2 plus a batch of 4 through the HTTP workers. Generated text is byte-identical between main (`8d4e1ce4c7`) and this PR.

## Speed Tests and Profiling

No steady-state serving change: this only affects how workers are spawned. Worker respawn under CPU saturation, CPU only:
- A uvicorn supervisor with 2 workers, started from a module that imports `sglang.launch_server` at top level, as the real launcher does.
- Each worker app imports `sglang.srt.entrypoints.http_server`.
- `timeout_worker_healthcheck=10`, 16 CPUs.
- Once both workers serve, one is SIGKILLed. Run length 180 s.

3 runs per arm, 96 busy loops / 16 CPUs, same machine. The "main" arm runs upstream main (`8d4e1ce4c7`). The "this PR" arm runs this branch; its harness marks itself as the sglang launcher, since it stands in for `python -m sglang.launch_server`.

| arm | health-check kills per run | respawn after the injected kill serves after (s) |
|---|---|---|
| main | 4, 10, 7 | 48.8, never, never |
| this PR | 0, 0, 0 | 53.4, 47.5, 36.4 |

- Not counted above: each run also has 1 injected SIGKILL.
- "never": the respawned worker was still being killed by the health check when the 180 s run ended.
- Times are host-specific. On a second host (16 CPUs of an 8x H100 server node, same busy loops) the re-import took longer: 30.5 s at 96 busy loops. There, main also had repeated health-check kills, and the PR had none.

At 48 busy loops, main was not killed by the health check: the re-import (8.8 s) stays just under the 10 s timeout.

## Checklist

- [x] Format your code according to the [Format code with pre-commit](https://docs.sglang.io/developer_guide/contribution_guide.html#format-code-with-pre-commit). (`pre-commit run` on the changed files: all hooks passed.)
- [x] Add unit tests according to the [Run and add unit tests](https://docs.sglang.io/developer_guide/contribution_guide.html#run-and-add-unit-tests). `test/registered/unit/entrypoints/test_uvicorn_worker_spawn.py` (CPU, `base-a-test-cpu`, `CustomTestCase`) covers four things:
  - for sglang's entrypoint, the preparation data drops the main-module keys only inside the context;
  - for any other launcher script the keys are kept;
  - the multi-tokenizer HTTP server calls `uvicorn.run` inside the context (`uvicorn.run` stubbed, no server started), and `spawn` is restored afterwards;
  - a 2-worker uvicorn server whose main module sleeps 600 s on re-import still serves, which never happens without the change.
- [ ] Update documentation according to [Write documentations](https://docs.sglang.io/developer_guide/contribution_guide.html#write-documentations). No user-facing flag or behavior to document.
- [x] Provide accuracy and speed benchmark results according to [Test the accuracy](https://docs.sglang.io/developer_guide/contribution_guide.html#test-the-accuracy) and [Benchmark the speed](https://docs.sglang.io/developer_guide/contribution_guide.html#benchmark-the-speed). (exactness gate and respawn measurements above)
- [x] Follow the SGLang code style [guidance](https://docs.sglang.io/developer_guide/contribution_guide.html#code-style-guidance).

Prepared with the help of Claude Code; every result above was measured as described.

## Review and Merge Process

1. Ping Merge Oncalls to start the process. See the [PR Merge Process](https://github.com/sgl-project/sglang/blob/main/.github/MAINTAINER.md#pull-request-merge-process).
2. Get approvals from [CODEOWNERS](https://github.com/sgl-project/sglang/blob/main/.github/CODEOWNERS) and other reviewers.
3. Trigger CI tests with [comments](https://docs.sglang.io/developer_guide/contribution_guide.html#how-to-trigger-ci-tests) or contact authorized users to do so.
   - Common commands include `/tag-and-rerun-ci`, `/tag-run-ci-label`, `/rerun-failed-ci`
4. After green CI and required approvals, ask Merge Oncalls or people with Write permission to merge the PR.

+import contextlib
+import os
+import sys
+from multiprocessing import spawn
+
+
+def _launched_by_sglang_entrypoint() -> bool:
+    main = sys.modules["__main__"]
+    spec = getattr(main, "__spec__", None)
+    if spec is not None:
+        return spec.name == "sglang.launch_server"
+    return os.path.basename(getattr(main, "__file__", None) or "") == "sglang"
+
+
+@contextlib.contextmanager
+def skip_main_reimport_in_spawned_workers():
+    """Spawned children do not re-run sglang's launcher module as ``__main__``.
+
+    The spawn start method re-runs the parent's main module in every child
+    before it unpickles the target. For ``python -m sglang.launch_server`` that
+    imports torch, transformers and most of sglang before uvicorn's health-check
+    thread exists in the worker. On a loaded host this exceeds
+    ``SGLANG_UVICORN_WORKER_HEALTHCHECK_TIMEOUT``, so the supervisor kills the
+    worker and spawns a new one, which hits the same timeout.
+
+    A uvicorn worker unpickles only uvicorn objects and imports the app from an
+    import string, so it needs nothing from sglang's launcher module. A user's
+    own launcher script still runs in every worker, since it may register
+    models or patches at module level.
+    """
+    if not _launched_by_sglang_entrypoint():
+        yield
+        return
+
+    get_preparation_data = spawn.get_preparation_data
+
+    def get_preparation_data_without_main(name):
+        data = get_preparation_data(name)
+        data.pop("init_main_from_name", None)
+        data.pop("init_main_from_path", None)
+        return data
+
+    spawn.get_preparation_data = get_preparation_data_without_main
+    try:
+        yield
+    finally:
+        spawn.get_preparation_data = get_preparation_data

@@ -0,0 +1,181 @@
+"""uvicorn workers spawned by the multi-tokenizer HTTP server must not re-run
+sglang's launcher module as ``__main__``: a slow main module would delay each
+worker's health-check thread past the supervisor's timeout, and the
+supervisor would kill and respawn it in a loop. A user's own launcher script
+still runs in every worker.
+"""
+
+import os
+import signal
+import socket
+import subprocess
+import sys
+import tempfile
+import textwrap
+import time
+import unittest
+import urllib.request
+from multiprocessing import spawn
+from types import SimpleNamespace
+from unittest import mock
+
+from uvicorn.config import LOGGING_CONFIG
+
+from sglang.srt.entrypoints import http_server, uvicorn_worker_spawn
+from sglang.srt.entrypoints.uvicorn_worker_spawn import (
+    skip_main_reimport_in_spawned_workers,
+)
+from sglang.test.ci.ci_register import register_cpu_ci
+from sglang.test.test_utils import CustomTestCase
+
+register_cpu_ci(est_time=15, suite="base-a-test-cpu")
+
+_MAIN_KEYS = ("init_main_from_name", "init_main_from_path")
+
+_SLOW_MAIN_SERVER = textwrap.dedent(
+    """
+    import sys
+    import time
+
+    if __name__ == "__mp_main__":
+        time.sleep(600)
+
+
+    async def app(scope, receive, send):
+        await send({"type": "http.response.start", "status": 200, "headers": []})
+        await send({"type": "http.response.body", "body": b"ok"})
+
+
+    if __name__ == "__main__":
+        import uvicorn
+
+        from sglang.srt.entrypoints import uvicorn_worker_spawn
+
+        # Stand in for python -m sglang.launch_server, whose re-import is slow
+        # on a loaded host.
+        uvicorn_worker_spawn._launched_by_sglang_entrypoint = lambda: True
+        with uvicorn_worker_spawn.skip_main_reimport_in_spawned_workers():
+            uvicorn.run(
+                "slow_main_server:app",
+                host="127.0.0.1",
+                port=int(sys.argv[1]),
+                workers=2,
+                timeout_worker_healthcheck=5,
+                lifespan="off",
+                log_level="warning",
+            )
+    """
+)
+
+
+def _free_port():
+    with socket.socket() as s:
+        s.bind(("127.0.0.1", 0))
+        return s.getsockname()[1]
+
+
+class TestUvicornWorkerSpawn(CustomTestCase):
+    def test_main_module_dropped_only_inside_context(self):
+        self.assertTrue(
+            any(k in spawn.get_preparation_data("outside") for k in _MAIN_KEYS)
+        )
+        original = spawn.get_preparation_data
+
+        with mock.patch.object(
+            uvicorn_worker_spawn, "_launched_by_sglang_entrypoint", return_value=True
+        ):
+            with skip_main_reimport_in_spawned_workers():
+                data = spawn.get_preparation_data("inside")
+                self.assertFalse(any(k in data for k in _MAIN_KEYS))
+                self.assertIn("sys_path", data)
+
+        self.assertIs(spawn.get_preparation_data, original)
+
+    def test_user_launcher_script_still_runs_in_workers(self):
+        self.assertFalse(uvicorn_worker_spawn._launched_by_sglang_entrypoint())
+        with skip_main_reimport_in_spawned_workers():
+            data = spawn.get_preparation_data("inside")
+            self.assertTrue(any(k in data for k in _MAIN_KEYS))
+
+    def test_http_server_starts_uvicorn_workers_inside_the_context(self):
+        original = spawn.get_preparation_data
+        main_keys_seen_by_workers = []
+
+        def fake_uvicorn_run(app_path, **kwargs):
+            data = spawn.get_preparation_data("worker")
+            main_keys_seen_by_workers.append([k for k in _MAIN_KEYS if k in data])
+
+        serving = SimpleNamespace(
+            tokenizer_worker_num=2,
+            enable_http2=False,
+            enable_ssl_refresh=False,
+            enable_http_worker_reuseport=False,
+            host="127.0.0.1",
+            port=30000,
+            fastapi_root_path="",
+            ssl_certfile=None,
+            ssl_keyfile=None,
+            ssl_ca_certs=None,
+            ssl_keyfile_password=None,
+        )
+        with (
+            mock.patch.object(
+                uvicorn_worker_spawn,
+                "_launched_by_sglang_entrypoint",
+                return_value=True,
+            ),
+            mock.patch.object(http_server, "get_serving", return_value=serving),
+            mock.patch.object(
+                http_server,
+                "get_observability",
+                return_value=SimpleNamespace(log_level_http=None, log_level="error"),
+            ),
+            mock.patch.object(http_server, "set_global_state"),
+            mock.patch.object(http_server, "_global_state", None),
+            mock.patch.object(http_server, "write_data_for_multi_tokenizer"),
+            mock.patch.object(http_server, "set_uvicorn_logging_configs"),
+            mock.patch.dict(LOGGING_CONFIG["loggers"]),
+            mock.patch.object(http_server.uvicorn, "run", side_effect=fake_uvicorn_run),
+        ):
+            http_server._setup_and_run_http_server(
+                server_args=None,
+                tokenizer_manager=mock.Mock(),
+                template_manager=None,
+                port_args=None,
+                scheduler_infos=[{}],
+                subprocess_watchdog=None,
+            )
+
+        self.assertEqual(main_keys_seen_by_workers, [[]])
+        self.assertIs(spawn.get_preparation_data, original)
+
+    def test_workers_serve_although_main_module_is_slow(self):
+        with tempfile.TemporaryDirectory() as tmp_dir:
+            with open(os.path.join(tmp_dir, "slow_main_server.py"), "w") as f:
+                f.write(_SLOW_MAIN_SERVER)
+            port = _free_port()
+            proc = subprocess.Popen(
+                [sys.executable, "slow_main_server.py", str(port)],
+                cwd=tmp_dir,
+                start_new_session=True,
+            )
+            try:
+                deadline = time.monotonic() + 60
+                body = None
+                while time.monotonic() < deadline and proc.poll() is None:
+                    try:
+                        with urllib.request.urlopen(
+                            f"http://127.0.0.1:{port}/", timeout=2
+                        ) as r:
+                            body = r.read()
+                        break
+                    except OSError:
+                        time.sleep(0.5)
+                self.assertEqual(body, b"ok")
+            finally:
+                os.killpg(proc.pid, signal.SIGKILL)
+                proc.wait()
+
+
+if __name__ == "__main__":
+    unittest.main()
